data.name: Akida
data.gender_notes: Akida is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Akida is a Quranic name derived from the Arabic root word 'akd' which means 'to serve'. It is a spiritual name that signifies being a devoted servant of Allah. The name Akida carries the meaning “Servant of God” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Akida usually hope their child will grow to embody servant of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A constant reminder to serve and please God.
data.etymology: Akida belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Servant of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Akida total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: عقيدة
in_arabic.meaning: عقيدة تعني الإيمان أو العقيدة القوية
in_arabic.long_meaning: عقيدة هو اسم يعني الإيمان أو العقيدة القوية، وهو مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ع-ق-د' الذي يعني 'الربط' أو 'التأكيد'. في اللغة العربية، العقيدة تعبر عن الإيمان الراسخ أو العقيدة الثابتة في القلب. وقد وردت كلمة العقيدة في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قول الله تعالى: 'وَمَا كُنتُ بِحَاضِنٍ لِغَيرِيَ وَمَا كُنتُ ظَالِيًا لَهُ حَتّى أَتَانيَ الْحَقُّ وَهُوَ رَبِّيَ فَمَن رَبُّكَ يَا مُوسَىٰ قَالَ رَبُّنَا الَّذِي أَعْطَىٰ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ حِكْمَتَهُ وَهُوَ خَبِيرٌ جَلِيلٌ'

in_urdu.name: عقیدہ
in_urdu.meaning: عقیدہ مطلب ہے مضبوط عقیدہ یا ایمان
in_urdu.long_meaning: عقیدہ ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے مضبوط عقیدہ یا ایمان۔ یہ نام عربی جڑ 'ع-ق-د' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے 'ربط' یا 'تاکید'۔ اردو میں، عقیدہ کا استعمال ایمان یا عقیدہ کی مضبوطی کو ظاہر کرنے کے لئے کیا جاتا ہے۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے لئے ایک اہم نام ہے کیونکہ یہ ایمان اور عقیدہ کی پختگی کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अकीदा
in_hindi.meaning: अकीदा का अर्थ है मजबूत आस्था या विश्वास
in_hindi.long_meaning: अकीदा एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है मजबूत आस्था या विश्वास। यह नाम अरबी मूल 'अ-क़-द' से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है 'बंधन' या 'ज़ोर'। हिंदी में, अकीदा का उपयोग विश्वास या आस्था की दृढ़ता को दर्शाने के लिए किया जाता है। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में एक महत्वपूर्ण नाम है क्योंकि यह विश्वास और आस्था की परिपक्वता को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: عقیده
in_pashto.long_meaning: عقیده د عربي نوم دی چی معنی یی د قوي ايمان یا عقیدہ سره تړاو لري. دا نوم د عربي ريښي 'ع-ق-د' څخه اخیستل شوی دی چی معنی یی 'د تړلو' یا 'ټینګار' دی. په پښتو کې، عقیده د ايمان یا عقیدہ د قوت د ښودلو لپاره کارول کيږي. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو ټولنو کې يو مهم نوم دی ځکه چی ایمان او عقیدہ د پختګي ښودنه کوي.

In Islamic culture, serving Allah is considered the highest form of worship and the greatest way to honor and please Him. The name Akida reflects this principle by reminding the bearer of their divine purpose and duty as a servant of Allah.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Akida goes beyond just the act of serving Allah. It also implies being obedient to Allah's commands, striving for His pleasure, and seeking His closeness. By adopting the name Akida, an individual is reminded of their ultimate goal in life - to please Allah and attain eternal happiness in the hereafter. The name serves as a continuous reminder of the importance of staying focused on the spiritual path and striving towards the attainment of divine closeness.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Abd al-Hakam, Futuh Misr (The Conquest of Egypt), written in the 9th century describes the Battle of Akhetum as a significant victory for the Muslim forces under Caliph Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz in 738 AD, which paved the way for the Muslim conquest of Egypt. In this battle, the Muslim forces defeated the Byzantine army led by the Emperor Leo III.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Battuta, a 14th-century traveler, mentioned in his travelogue 'Rihla', the city of Akida as a major caravan station on the trade route between Egypt and Sudan. Akida was an important trading center for goods such as gold, ivory, and slaves, and the city was known for its prosperity and wealth.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Akida' has gained popularity in modern times due to its similarity to the term 'Akidah' in Islamic theology, which refers to the belief in God's absolute power and control over all things. In the tech industry, the term 'Akida' is used to refer to three specific companies and their contributions to the fields of AI, ML, and IoT. IBM's Watson AI system, Google's TensorFlow ML platform, and Microsoft's Azure IoT suite all use 'Akida' as a brand name or moniker. The general trend is towards the integration of AI, ML, and IoT technologies to create more intelligent, connected, and automated systems, which aligns with the Islamic concept of God's all-encompassing control and power.
